source.title: 7th National Report of the Philippines to the Convention on Biological Diversity
source.reportingAuthority: Department of Environment and Natural Resources - Biodiversity Management Bureau
source.locator: Wetlands section and Table 5 of the CBD Online Reporting Tool record
source.reviewNotes: The report says it summarizes PBSAP implementation from 2018 to 2024 and gives national wetland status figures; the reviewed section is not a CALABARZON site list.

reportedMetrics.sourceDescription: National DENR report figures; site-level inventory and regional breakdown were not present in the reviewed section.
The report attributes this table to PHILCHM and cites a 6 December 2025 retrieval.

consistencyChecks.check: PHILCHM page total versus island-group sum

calabarzonCrosswalk.regionalDevelopmentPlan2021Figures: 19 inland wetlands (16 lakes and three water-storage areas), 116320.22 hectares, and 354 river systems are previously reported regional aggregates; no site roster was read in this review.
calabarzonCrosswalk.roadmap2024Figures: The official CALABARZON roadmap states 30 wetlands but enumerates 31 mixed site/habitat phrases; exact count and feature identity remain unresolved.

limitations: The two national counts refer to differently described data products and cannot be combined into one total.
The national report gives no CALABARZON site roster or CALABARZON-specific share in the reviewed section.
The presence of a dataset title in DENR DPCAS or an ENR report table outline does not mean its underlying rows were accessible or reviewed.
No fish occurrence, current wetland condition, access, legal status, or regional inventory completeness follows from these counts.
